13-Day Grand Turkey & Jordan: Ephesus to the Dead Sea
summary:
The 13-Day Turkey & Jordan Tour gives Turkey a broader western route before continuing into Jordan’s archaeological heartland. Explore Istanbul and Cappadocia, then travel west to Pamukkale and ancient Ephesus before flying to Amman. The Jordan section continues to Petra, followed by an overnight desert camp in Wadi Rum and time at the Dead Sea. This combination adds Turkey’s Aegean heritage to Jordan’s historic and desert landscapes without introducing additional countries.
The escorted program includes selected 4-star hotels, one night in a desert camp, breakfast, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, airport transfers, three domestic flights and private transportation throughout Jordan.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise - Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. Transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour- Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Full day Ephesus tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Enter through the Magnesia Gate and walk past remarkable landmarks including the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the impressive Great Theatre, where Saint Paul once preached. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. After lunch, visit the sacred House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Pamukkale tour - Flight to Istanbul.
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Denizli Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 21:15. Upon arrival at 22:35, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Amman By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Amman.
Upon arrival Amman Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Amman, Jerash and Aljoun
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Amman. Enjoy a panoramic city tour, including visits to the Amman Citadel, Roman Theatre, and the Folklore Museum. Continue to Ajloun Castle before visiting the ancient Roman city of Jerash, including Hadrian’s Arch, the Hippodrome, the Forum, and its famous colonnaded streets. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Madaba, Mt Nebo and Kerak
itinerary.text: Visit St. George’s Church in Madaba and see the famous mosaic map of the Holy Land. Continue to Mount Nebo for panoramic views over the Jordan Valley. Drive along the scenic Wadi Mujib route to visit Kerak Castle before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra and Wadi Rum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Petra. Explore the ancient city of Petra, including the Siq, the famous Al-Khazneh (Treasury), the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. An optional horse ride is available at the entrance of Petra. Continue to Wadi Rum and enjoy a 4x4 jeep safari through the desert landscape. Overnight at a desert camp in Wadi Rum.

itinerary.title: Visit Dead Seaand then return to Amman
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the desert camp in Wadi Rum. Proceed to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth.
Enjoy free time to relax and float in its mineral-rich waters before continuing to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Amman
Check-out and transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for your return flight

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Turkey & Jordan Tour – 13 Days?
faqs.a: The 13-Day Turkey & Jordan Tour combines the highlights of Turkey and Jordan. The itinerary includes Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus in Turkey, along with Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea in Jordan. This journey offers a perfect blend of ancient civilizations, stunning landscapes, cultural heritage, and world-famous archaeological sites. The tour runs for 12 nights and 13 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Turkey & Jordan Tour – 13 Days cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,875 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and four domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, four domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights help maximize sightseeing time and ensure comfortable travel between major destinations. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Jordan. Your guides will provide expert insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines the most famous attractions of both countries, providing an excellent introduction to the region's rich history, culture, and natural beauty.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historical districts, desert landscapes, and uneven terrain. Petra requires a considerable amount of walking, while most other sightseeing is suitable for visitors with average fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia; the white travertine terraces of Pamukkale; the ancient city of Ephesus; the Roman ruins of Amman; the spectacular rose-red city of Petra; the dramatic desert scenery of Wadi Rum; and the unique floating experience in the Dead Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Turkey & Jordan Tour – 13 Days?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Turkey & Jordan Tour – 13 Days be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional destinations such as Aqaba or Jerash, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
